title: CRISPR-Cas9 genome-editing schematic
alt: Stepwise schematic showing guide RNA and Cas9 locating a DNA sequence, cutting it, and enabling deletion or insertion during repair.
caption: A CRISPR-Cas9 mechanism schematic; the chapter then asks who may authorize heritable changes and who bears their consequences.
teachingUse: Establishes the physical intervention before students consider heritability, consent, fairness, and governance.
